title: Hydrolysis of aspartame and hydroxylation of its phenylalanine
compartment: Small-intestinal brush border and mucosa, then liver

steps.note: Releases L-aspartate; esterases can act first, forming aspartylphenylalanine

steps.enzyme: Esterases of intestinal mucosa and blood
steps.note: Releases methanol, at most 10% of aspartame by weight
